create_ErrorReport: create an ErrorReport instance to collect and manage BMG compiler errors during model compilation
add_error_to_report: add a BMGError instance to an ErrorReport using the add_error method for tracking compilation issues
raise_errors_from_report: raise a ValueError with all collected errors by calling raise_errors on an ErrorReport instance
create_Violation_error: create a Violation error to report type requirement mismatches between a node and its consumer
create_UnsupportedNode_error: create an UnsupportedNode error to report graph operations not supported by Bean Machine Graph
